about: Line-coverage floors, in percent, for the critical areas of src-tauri/src, checked by scripts/ci/coverage_areas.py in the rust-coverage job after the total ratchet (.github/coverage-baseline.txt).
Paths are relative to src-tauri/src: * stays within one path segment, ** spans any number.
Set on 2026-10-20 from CI's own measurement on master (runs 39249242727 at ce5dd006 and 39230596668 at aa69fc93): the lower of the two, less half a point, rounded down to a tenth.

Raise a floor when the job's notice says the area is a point above it. Never lower one without a written reason in the commit message, and never exclude code to meet it. A moved folder moves its paths here in the same change.
